summary: Establish a working GPU environment while distinguishing the device, driver, toolkit, compiler and framework runtime.
outcomes: Explain which software layer is responsible for a failed GPU launch.
Record and validate a supported environment with a small device query and test.
sequence: Draw application, runtime, driver and hardware layers.
Identify actual hardware and operating-system constraints.
Read the applicable compatibility matrix before installing.
Build a tiny query and vector operation with explicit architecture targets.
Diagnose missing device, library and unsupported binary cases.

visual.question: Why can a framework see a GPU while a source build fails?
visual.interaction: Choose a hypothetical stack and reveal which compatibility checks pass.

practice.task: Produce an environment manifest and diagnose two supplied failure logs.
practice.success: Manifest separates installed driver, toolkit, runtime and target architecture; diagnosis names the failing layer.
